slides.headline: Stop fixing mistakes. Fix the system.
Most people debug the *OUTPUT*
slides.body: Something breaks → we patch the symptom.

slides.headline: Operators debug the *PROCESS*
slides.body: Find what failed upstream, then redesign it.

slides.headline: Every failure is one of 3 layers
1) What specifically broke?
slides.body: Describe the output. Not the feeling.

slides.headline: 2) Where did it break?
slides.body: Prompt vs skill gap vs workflow step.

slides.headline: My job is to automate my job.
slides.body: Every recurring error is a system waiting to be fixed.
